info.title: Site Task AI assistant API
info.description: Authenticated command mailbox. SQLite on the user's computer is authoritative. Configure the server URL and bearer secret only after approved deployment. Commands are asynchronous; poll their status. Cloud deletion is recoverable soft deletion only.

command_id.description: A new lowercase canonical UUID for each intended operation. Retry the same immutable request with the same UUID.

source_reference.description: CLOUD:<uuid> or an existing PROJECT reference

base_revision.description: Current business_revision for every write except create. Null for get/create.

fields.description: All six fields for create; nonempty subset for update. due_date and no_due must be supplied together. Null for other operations.

200.description: Same owner and immutable request already accepted

409.description: Conflict; do not silently overwrite or change command contents

get.summary: Read the submitting credential's command status and receipt

post.summary: Cancel an unleased command owned by this credential

409.description: Already leased or finalized; too late to cancel

get.summary: Read a paginated non-authoritative task mirror

200.description: items, authoritative=false and next_after; null cursor means no next page

get.summary: Read a non-authoritative mirror identity; use get command for a live local read

200.description: items; may be metadata-only when content expired

get.summary: Read connection freshness and pending command count

200.description: last_seen_at, fenced, queued and identity watermarks
